articles.title: In Chase for ace in 2027, Cincinnati Reds slow Burns way down in 2026
articles.description: "We've got it all mapped out," Reds manager Terry Francona said without offering many details in Chase Burns innings limits for his final 3 starts.

articles.title: Cincinnati Reds 2B Matt McLain sidelined by shoulder soreness
articles.description: Cincinnati Reds second baseman hurt his surgically repaired left (non-throwing) shoulder on a diving play Friday against the Brewers.

articles.title: Cincinnati Reds make wrong kind of history in another high-scoring loss
articles.description: MLB's top two teams have clobbered the Cincinnati Reds so hard the past three games it made ignominious history for baseball's oldest franchise.

articles.title: Cincinnati Reds LHP Andrew Abbott on the worst start of his career
articles.description: Cincinnati Reds starter Andrew Abbott lasted just two innings and faced 15 batters, eight of whom scored on nine hits, in a 20-0 loss to the Brewers.

articles.title: Fall League at-bats in play for Reds' injured Spencer Steer (wrist)?
articles.description: Spencer Steer, one of the Cincinnati Reds' most consistent hitters and their most versatile fielder, expected to avoid surgery on injured wrist.

articles.title: Reds roll craps after detour through Las Vegas, routed by Brewers
articles.description: Hot Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz had his streak of consecutive games with a homer snapped at 5 as Brewers clinch 8th playoff berth in 9 years.

articles.title: Cincinnati Reds clobbered as Los Angeles Dodgers complete sweep
articles.description: Elly De La Cruz drove in four runs with three home runs, but the rest of the Cincinnati Reds did little during the Dodgers' three-game sweep.

articles.title: How far are Cincinnati Reds from two-time-champion Dodgers on field?
articles.description: "There's a good team in here that can compete for the playoffs next year." What makes Cincinnati Reds believe this?

articles.title: Cincinnati Reds get 1st home series win over Brewers since 2022
articles.description: The Reds snapped a nine-series losing streak to the Brewers at home with a slugfest win at Great American Ball Park Sept. 6.

articles.title: Reds rookie Rhett Lowder on rough start in 14-1 loss to Dodgers
articles.description: Cincinnati Reds starter Rhett Lowder (6-10, 5.81) got knocked out of the game during a 6-run Dodger fourth, charged with 7 runs in 3.1 IP overall.

articles.title: Cincinnati Reds at Los Angeles Dodgers odds, picks and predictions
articles.description: The Cincinnati Reds and Los Angeles Dodgers meet Monday to commence a 3-game series. First pitch from Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles, California, is set for 9:10 p.m. ET.
